# Techdirt

> Techdirt is a leading digital rights and tech policy publication covering First Amendment issues, internet regulation, free speech, and platform governance through original reporting, podcasts, and curated editions.

Founded by Mike Masnick, Techdirt provides in-depth analysis of constitutional law, tech policy, and content moderation issues. The site offers specialized content editions (GreenHouse, Free Speech, Web Monetization, Ctrl-Alt-Speech) and maintains a community-supported model through memberships and donations.

## Key Topics

- First Amendment
- Free Speech
- Constitutional Law
- Internet Regulation
- Content Moderation
- Platform Governance
- Church-State Separation
- Tech Policy
- Digital Rights
- Web Monetization
- SOPA/PIPA
- Court Rulings
- Mike Masnick
- Ctrl-Alt-Speech
- GreenHouse

## Core Content & Editions

- [Techdirt Homepage](https://www.techdirt.com): Main hub covering First Amendment, constitutional law, and free speech issues
- [Free Speech Edition](https://www.techdirt.com/edition/freespeech): Dedicated coverage of First Amendment, constitutional law, and religious liberty issues
- [GreenHouse Edition](https://www.techdirt.com/edition/greenhouse): Tech policy focus covering internet regulation, SOPA, PIPA, and legislative issues
- [Ctrl-Alt-Speech Podcast](https://www.techdirt.com/edition/ctrlaltspeech): Audio series exploring content moderation, platform governance, and free speech debates
- [Web Monetization Edition](https://www.techdirt.com/edition/webmonetization): Coverage of digital business models, micropayments, and content monetization strategies
- [Techdirt Podcast](https://www.techdirt.com/blog/podcast): Podcast edition featuring discussions on AI, technology debates, and decentralized internet

## Community & Support

- [Support Techdirt](https://www.techdirt.com/support): Membership, donation options, and Patreon support to sustain independent journalism
- [My Techdirt Account](https://www.techdirt.com/my-account): User account login and authentication for Techdirt members and subscribers
- [Techdirt Preferences](https://www.techdirt.com/preferences): Customize account settings, notification preferences, and user experience options
